name: Tim Zajic
office: West Basin Municipal Water District, Member, Board of Directors, Division 1

items.text: Tim Zajic is an engineer and environmental advocate running for West Basin Municipal Water District Board of Directors, Division 1. He worked as a research staff member at Lockheed Martin. He says he holds a Stanford engineering doctorate. His campaign says he will focus on water consumers over special interests, support fiscal responsibility, plan for climate-driven hydrology, and restudy desalination.
